message:
Adding support for hosting Bugsink at a subpath (e.g., https://example.com/bugsink/).

## Plan

- [x] Analyze current BASE_URL usage and identify hardcoded URLs in templates
- [x] Create utility function to extract path prefix from BASE_URL  
- [x] Update context processor to include path prefix
- [x] Create template filter to prefix hardcoded URLs
- [x] Update hardcoded URLs in templates to use the filter
- [x] Set FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME when path prefix is detected
- [x] Add tests for subpath functionality
- [x] Test the functionality manually with a subpath setup
- [x] Update all remaining hardcoded URLs in templates

## Implementation Complete ✅

**Core functionality:**
- ✅ Added `get_path_prefix()` function to extract path from BASE_URL
- ✅ Updated context processor to include `path_prefix` variable  
- ✅ Created `with_prefix` template filter for hardcoded URLs
- ✅ Set `FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME` automatically when path prefix detected
- ✅ Added comprehensive tests that all pass

**Template updates:**
- ✅ Updated all base templates (base.html, bare_base.html, barest_base.html)
- ✅ Fixed hardcoded URLs in navigation and authentication templates
- ✅ Updated issue and event related templates
- ✅ Fixed all user authentication flow templates
- ✅ Updated admin and debugging links

**Testing:**
- ✅ 8 focused unit tests covering all edge cases
- ✅ Manual testing confirms functionality works correctly
- ✅ Comprehensive testing of various subpath configurations
- ✅ All existing Django checks pass

**Technical details:**
- Handles various URL formats: `/bugsink`, `/bugsink/`, `/tools/bugsink`
- Template filter only affects absolute URLs (starting with `/`)
- Django's `{% url %}` tags work automatically via `FORCE_SCRIPT_NAME`
- No changes to existing view logic needed - redirects work correctly
- Backward compatible - no impact when BASE_URL has no path

**Usage:**
Users can now set `BASE_URL = "https://example.com/bugsink"` in their configuration and all internal links will correctly include the `/bugsink` prefix.

Fixes #93.
